messages:
morgan: Heads up — publish CI failed for js-sdk. typegen output changed hash even though only CHANGELOG.md was edited. Anyone run into this before?

sara: Yep, saw the same. CI log shows: `typegen --out libs/js` produced a diff for types/index.d.ts (reordered interfaces). No source model changes.

james: That sounds like nondeterministic ordering from the OpenAPI generator. Did you run `yarn regen` locally?

morgan: I ran `yarn regen` and got a different result than CI, so CI flagged a regen-diff.

olivia: Repro steps I used: `git checkout release/candidate && yarn && yarn regen`. Locally the hash flipped depending on node version. Suspect filesystem dir iteration order.

devx-bot: deploybot: publish-js-sdk job #482 failed — exit code 1 — regen-diff detected. See CI artifacts: /artifacts/482/regen-diff.patch

sara: Quick debug: openapi -> codegen sometimes emits properties in object iteration order. I'll add a deterministic sort in the typegen post-process to stable-sort keys and imports. Should fix hash flip.

james: We should also add a regen CI check that runs `yarn regen` in a clean container and fails the job early if there are diffs. Saves a full publish cycle.

olivia: Sample app broke too: import paths changed because index export order swapped. I pushed a failing test in sampleapp CI to catch import reorder issues.

morgan: For immediate unblock I'm going to revert the CHANGELOG semver bump -> pushed a hotfix branch. We shouldn't bump minor for docs-only changes.

sara::+1: I'll open a PR with a post-process step that does: `sortObjectKeys` + stable import ordering. Will include a small unit test using deterministic fixture.

james: I'll add a CI job `regen-check` that runs `node ./scripts/regen-check.js` on PRs that touch openapi/ or packages/*/types. If any diffs, fail fast.

olivia: I'll add a sampleapp e2e that runs a type import smoke test after regen. If imports move, fail.

morgan: Sounds good. Assigning: sara -> typegen post-process PR; james -> regen-check CI job; olivia -> sampleapp guard. I'll file an issue with CI logs and attach the regen-diff patch.

sara: ETA for PR: today afternoon.

james: I'll draft the regen-check job and a small script to compare `git status --porcelain` after regen.

olivia: After those land we can re-run the publish pipeline.

morgan: Thanks team. Logged issue: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DX-1294 — added labels: typegen, ci, release.

sara: Good catch — also adding a note to the release playbook: "no semver bump for docs-only unless accompanied by regen pass".

morgan: Agreed. Closing the loop after PRs merge.
